newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-PLAYERS REACT ANGRILY TO NEW YEAR FIXTURE DEAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PLAYERS REACT ANGRILY TO NEW YEAR FIXTURE DEAL.

text.p: The Spanish league's New Year fixture programme is still in doubt after players reacted angrily to a proposal to reschedule games from December 29 to January 1.
"We've gone from bad to worse," Espanyol goalkeeper Toni Jimenez said after learning of the agreement in principle reached by the players's association and Spanish Football League.
The players, who have yet to ratify the agreement reached by their union, favoured moving the games to January 22 and have threatened to strike for their demand.
